homeWalkIns.title: Walk-ins are available at all ZOMAK clinics
homeWalkIns.firstParagraph: Visit any ZOMAK clinic for walk-in support across everyday health needs, family care, forms, testing direction, and same-day questions.
homeWalkIns.secondParagraph: Availability can vary by provider schedule and daily clinic volume, so calling ahead is recommended when timing matters.

homeAbout.statement: We are dedicated to providing high-quality medical care tailored to your needs. Our team focuses on family health and walk-in care, ensuring every patient feels heard, supported, and confident in their care.
